body:
## What this ticket and audio tour includes

This WeGoTrip experience (`p3471`) combines **skip-the-line admission to the Picasso Museum (Museu Picasso)** in Barcelona with a **3-hour (`180 min`, 4 km) offline English audio tour** hosted by creator Alexandra. When verified on 28 October 2026, the package was listed from **€23.00 per person** (€19.55 with a WeGoTrip subscription) and held a **4.0/5 rating** across 60 ratings and 9 written reviews.

The route is structured in two parts:
1. **Museu Picasso Permanent Collection:** Traces Pablo Picasso's formative artistic development from his earliest serious paintings at age 15 through his Blue Period and later re-interpretations inside five connected medieval palaces on Carrer de Montcada.
2. **El Born & Ciutadella Walking Route:** Continues on foot through the Gothic streets of **El Born**, stopping at **Santa Maria del Mar Basilica**, the medieval jousting promenade of **Passeig del Born**, the archaeological ruins inside **El Born Centre de Cultura i Memòria** (free entry), the Cascade Fountain inside **Parc de la Ciutadella**, and the Modernista facade of the **Palau de la Música Catalana**.

## Important limitations and timing caveats

- **Permanent collection only:** The listing explicitly notes that the ticket and audio commentary cover the **main permanent exhibition only**; temporary exhibitions are excluded and have no audio narration.
- **Santa Maria del Mar afternoon fee:** While Santa Maria del Mar is free to enter during morning and evening hours, the basilica charges a **€5.00 admission fee between 13:00 (1:00 PM) and 17:00 (5:00 PM)** that is not included in the ticket price.
- **Offline app delivery:** Download the free WeGoTrip app (Android 7.1+ or iOS 12+, ~100 MB required) over Wi-Fi before heading to Carrer de Montcada so both your entry ticket and audio tracks work offline.
